result.description:
NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd
Walkaway, Western Australia

Full Time Irrigationist 
(2 Positions Available)

Salary
AUD $90,000 – $100,000 per annum plus Superannuation, depending on skills and experience.

About us:
NVD Fresh Produce Pty Ltd is a family-owned agricultural enterprise based in Walkaway, Western Australia, approximately 30 minutes from Geraldton. We operate approximately 4.2 hectares of plastic greenhouses in Walkaway and an additional 2 hectares of plastic greenhouses at the family’s original farm.

We are currently expanding our operations, having purchased 60 acres of land near Walkaway to support future growth and long-term sustainability. NVD Fresh Produce specialises in intensive greenhouse cultivation and is progressively diversifying its crop range, recognising crop rotation as a key strategy to preserve soil health, improve productivity, and maintain consistent supply.
The business is focused on strengthening its production capacity, improving operational systems and water management practices, and establishing a scalable and sustainable structure to support ongoing expansion within Western Australia’s fresh produce market.

The successful applicant will play an important role in supporting the continued growth and success of NVD Fresh Produce's farming operations.

Position Summary
The Irrigationist is responsible for installing, operating, monitoring and maintaining irrigation systems across NVD Fresh Produce's greenhouse and farming operations. The role supports efficient and sustainable water management by ensuring irrigation systems operate effectively to maximise crop productivity, water efficiency and workplace safety.

Key Responsibilities
Irrigation System Management
•	Determine hydraulic parameters for irrigation systems. 
•	Implement irrigation programs to meet crop production requirements. 
•	Schedule irrigation activities based on crop and seasonal requirements. 
•	Select, operate and manage irrigation pumps and related equipment. 
Irrigation Operations
•	Interpret irrigation plans and apply irrigation designs. 
•	Install, monitor and maintain irrigation systems. 
•	Identify and rectify faults in irrigation infrastructure. 
•	Monitor irrigation performance, water usage and system efficiency.
Farm Operations
•	Maintain irrigation equipment, pipelines, valves, filtration systems and controllers. 
•	Support continuous improvement of irrigation efficiency and sustainable water management practices.
•	Maintain accurate irrigation records. 
Workplace Safety and Team Support
•	Comply with workplace health and safety requirements. 
•	Work collaboratively with supervisors and other farm employees. 
•	Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications and Skills
Applicants should possess one of the following:
•	A relevant AQF Certificate II qualification (or equivalent) together with at least 1 year relevant post-qualification employment experience (20+hpw); or 
•	At least 2 years' full-time relevant employment experience in irrigation system installation, operation and maintenance. 

In addition, applicants should demonstrate:
•	Knowledge of irrigation systems, including pumps, pipelines, valves, filtration systems and irrigation controllers. 
•	Ability to install, operate, maintain and troubleshoot irrigation systems. 
•	Ability to interpret irrigation plans and schedules. 
•	Ability to follow work instructions and communicate effectively with supervisors and other team members. 
•	Ability to work cooperatively as part of a team. 
•	Current driver's licence or the ability to obtain one will be highly regarded. 
•	Commitment to workplace health and safety.



How to apply:

Applications open on 10 July 2026 and close on 9 August 2026
Please send your CV to info@businessnest.com.au. Please include the job role title in your email.

Join a growing telecommunications infrastructure company delivering advanced mobile coverage and wireless communication solutions across Australia, supporting complex commercial, infrastructure, and telecommunications projects.

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time Electronics Engineer
•	Salary from $80,000 to $90,000 p.a. plus superannuation
•	Position based in Kingsgrove NSW 2208

Position Overview
Digital Sydney Communications Pty Ltd specialises in mobile coverage solutions for telecommunications, commercial property, and infrastructure sectors. The company delivers Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS), In-Building Coverage solutions, outdoor network enhancements, and tower builds across complex commercial environments.

As the company expands nationally, operational delivery increasingly relies on advanced telecommunications and electronic systems managing RF performance, wireless coverage, network optimisation, testing, and operational reporting across multiple project sites. Skilled engineering capability is essential to maintaining network reliability, supporting project delivery, and ensuring scalable technical operations across the business.

We are seeking a full-time Electronics Engineer to support the design, testing, optimisation, commissioning, and maintenance of telecommunications and wireless communication systems across commercial and infrastructure projects.

Key Responsibilities:

•	Design and optimise DAS, small cell, and wireless communication systems
•	Conduct RF site surveys, path loss calculations, and signal testing
•	Perform PIM and swept frequency testing to resolve network issues
•	Install, configure, and optimise Nextivity Cel-Fi systems
•	Troubleshoot interference, signal leakage, and network performance issues
•	Prepare engineering documentation, commissioning reports, and as-built drawings
•	Ensure compliance with ACMA regulations and telecommunications standards
•	Collaborate with project teams and clients to deliver technical solutions
•	Research and recommend improvements to telecommunications technologies and systems

Required Skills and Qualifications:

•	Bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related field
•	Minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience as an Electronics Engineer or related occupation
•	Strong knowledge of RF systems, DAS technologies, wireless communications, and telecommunications infrastructure
•	Experience with RF testing equipment, spectrum analysers, PIM testing, and network optimisation activities
•	Knowledge of Australian telecommunications standards, ACMA regulations, and engineering compliance requirements
•	Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills
•	Ability to work collaboratively with operational, engineering, and project delivery teams

From $80,000 to $90,000 per annum, plus superannuation, depending on skills and experience.

Summary: 
Join an organisation that is shaping the future direction of modern computing systems in Australia, in an academic role that combines high-quality research, excellent teaching, and meaningful contribution to the School’s strategic priorities.

Job Details
•	Salary, 
o	Lecturer (Level B) – AUD $127,947 to $150,830 per annum + 17% superannuation
o	Senior Lecturer (Level C) – AUD $155,403 to $178,290 per annum + 17% superannuation
•	Full-time
•	2-Year Convertible Tenure Track or continuing appointment
•	Location: Kensington – Sydney, Australia

The Opportunity
Join the School of Computer Science and Engineering in the Faculty of Engineering at UNSW as a Lecturer / Senior Lecturer in a Teaching and Research role. In this role, you will contribute to the advancement of research and education in modern computing systems, while helping to shape the next generation of computing professionals.

You will conduct research in areas such as operating systems, distributed systems, system security and systems for AI, contributing to high-impact research outcomes and the School’s growing research profile. 

With established strengths in systems, AI/ML, cybersecurity, and distributed computing, UNSW offers an exceptional environment for academics who are looking to build their research profile, contribute to collaborative research initiatives, and deliver high-quality teaching. You will contribute to the development of scalable, secure, and high-performance computing systems.

This is an opportunity to join a global leader in Computer Science, with cutting-edge facilities, world-class faculty, and an innovative research environment. With strong industry partnerships and a commitment to sustainability, UNSW provides excellent opportunities for career development, collaboration, and impact.

About You
You are an emerging or established academic with a strong foundation in modern computing systems, with the ability to contribute to high-quality research and teaching. You bring expertise in areas such as operating systems, distributed systems, system security and systems for AI and demonstrate the potential to build a strong research profile.

At Lecturer level (Level B), you will be developing your research profile and contributing to collaborative research activities, including competitive grant applications and scholarly publications, while also delivering high-quality teaching and supporting student learning across undergraduate and postgraduate courses.

At Senior Lecturer level (Level C), you will demonstrate an established research track record with evidence of research leadership, success in securing competitive funding, supervising HDR students, and making significant independent contributions to your field. You will also contribute to educational leadership through high-quality teaching, curriculum development, and mentoring students and colleagues.

You are an engaging educator with experience in delivering high-quality teaching and contributing to curriculum development. You are collaborative, adaptable, and motivated to contribute to a high-performing academic environment and to build strong relationships across academia and industry.

About UNSW
UNSW is a world leading institution recognised for its scale, prestige, and impact. With strong industry engagement and partnerships across sectors, UNSW provides a unique environment where academic expertise translates into real world outcomes. The university is home to cutting edge research that drives innovation and societal progress, while its excellence in teaching ensures students are prepared to lead in their fields. For academics, UNSW offers an outstanding platform to flourish — combining world class facilities, collaborative networks, and a culture of innovation that supports both career growth and meaningful contributions to the wider community.

The School of Computer Science and Engineering is one of the largest and most prestigious schools of computing in Australia. It offers undergraduate programmes in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, and Bioinformatics, as well as a number of combined degrees with other disciplines. Our research and teaching staff are world leading and world building as they advance knowledge and learning. For more information on our school, please visit: https://www.unsw.edu.au/engineering/our-schools/computer-science-and-engineering 

Skills & Experience:
Lecturer (Level B)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design, development and delivery at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level.
•	Experience using and/or designing with educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence (e.g. relevant discipline-based curriculum design and development at a variety of levels and scales).
•	Demonstrated knowledge of industry or experience of work-integrated learning (desirable). 
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity, diversity and inclusion initiatives.

Senior Lecturer (Level C)
•	A PhD in a related discipline, and/or relevant work experience.
•	Proven commitment to proactively keeping up to date with discipline knowledge and developments.
•	Demonstrated experience in teaching and learning design using a range of pedagogical approaches, development and delivery of courses and programs, at undergraduate and/or postgraduate level. 
•	Experience of implementing educational technologies and online delivery methods.
•	Evidence of teaching effectiveness and passion for educational excellence and fostering this in others.
•	Demonstrated success in initiating curriculum development and improvement. 
•	Demonstrated experience with industry or work-integrated learning. 
•	Evidence of ability to support and inspire students from diverse backgrounds and support student equity diversity and inclusion initiatives.
•	Demonstrated track record in research with outcomes of high quality and high impact with clear evidence of the desire and ability to continually achieve research excellence as well as the capacity for research leadership.
•	Experience in successfully recruiting and supervising high calibre students.
•	Demonstrated ability to work in a team, collaborate across disciplines and build effective relationships.
•	Evidence of highly developed interpersonal and organisational skills.
•	Demonstrated ability to interact with the profession and industry and attract funding for learning and teaching initiatives.
•	An understanding of and commitment to UNSW’s aims, objectives and values in action, together with relevant policies and guidelines.
•	Knowledge of health and safety responsibilities and commitment to attending relevant health and safety training.

Additional details about the specific responsibilities for this position can be found in the position description. This is available via JOBS@UNSW. 

To Apply: 
If you are an emerging academic looking to build your research and teaching profile, or an established academic seeking to further your career, this opportunity offers the chance to contribute to high-quality research, deliver engaging teaching, and help shape the future direction of the School. We encourage you to click the “Apply Now” button and submit your CV, cover letter, and responses addressing the Skills and Experience criteria.

If this opportunity interests you, but your experience does not align perfectly with every selection criterion, we still encourage you to apply.

If you have had any interruption in your career, you are encouraged to include a ROPE statement as part of your application. For information on ROPE please check: 
https://www.arc.gov.au/about-arc/program-polici

result.description:
Autoservice Pinto Repair PTY LTD is seeking a skilled and experienced Automotive Electrician to join our team in Maidstone, Victoria. This is a full-time position that offers an excellent opportunity to work in a dynamic automotive service environment. As an Automotive Electrician, you will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing and maintaining electrical systems in vehicles, ensuring that all work meets safety standards and exceeds customer expectations. This role is integral to our operations, allowing us to deliver high-quality electrical services to our valued clients.
Key responsibilities:
•     Using test equipment to locate electrical and electronic malfunctions.
•     Dismantling and removing electrical and electronic assemblies and components.
•     Installing electrical equipment and electronic components in motor vehicles.
•     Connecting power-operated vehicle equipment and accessories to power supply.
•     Adjusting engine control systems and timing.
•     Testing and replacing defective alternators, generators, voltage regulators and starter motors.
•     Repairing and replacing faulty ignition and electrical wiring.
•     Replacing defective parts such as fuses, lamps and switches.
Qualifications:
•     Certificate III in Automotive Electrical Technology or equivalent qualification.
•     Current Driver Licence.
•     Air Conditioning Handling Licence (preferred but not essential).
Experience:
•     Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as an Automotive Electrician.
•     Experience diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining automotive electrical and electronic systems.
•     Experience working with a wide range of vehicle makes and models.
Skills:
•     Strong diagnostic and fault-finding skills.
•     Ability to repair and maintain vehicle electrical and electronic systems.
•     Knowledge of wiring systems, batteries, charging systems, starters, lighting, and electronic control systems.
•     Ability to use diagnostic equipment and technical manuals.
•     Basic knowledge of Roadworthy Certificate (RWC) inspection requirements and vehicle safety standards.
•     Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
•     Good communication and customer service skills.
•     Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
•     Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality workmanship.

What we offer:
At Autoservice Pinto Repair PTY LTD, we value our employees and are committed to providing a rewarding work environment. We offer competitive remuneration reflecting your skills and experience, ongoing professional development opportunities to keep you current with industry advancements, and a supportive team culture where your expertise is recognised and valued. We provide a safe, well-equipped workshop environment with modern diagnostic tools and equipment to support your work. We also offer flexible working arrangements where possible and encourage a healthy work-life balance. Our team-focused approach means you'll collaborate with experienced technicians and have access to mentorship and training to further develop your career.

About us:
Autoservice Pinto Repair PTY LTD is an automotive repair workshop located in Maidstone, Victoria. The company provides a wide range of automotive services, including mechanical repairs, vehicle servicing, diagnostics, and electrical fault diagnosis. Committed to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction, the business delivers reliable automotive solutions to both private and commercial clients.

We specialise in seamless integration across the Power Systems, Telecommunications, and Renewable Energy industries. Our expertise spans Power Systems Studies, Transmission Lines, Substations, Telecommunications, Protection, Control & Automation, Renewable Energy Connections, Mining, and Engineering, Protection Panel Design and Installation, 3D Design and Manufacturing as well as Construction/Management (EPC/M) services.

We have outstanding opportunity for a highly experienced and skilled ELECTRICAL ENGINEER . We are looking for trustworthy individuals with integrity who will bring a positive can-do attitude to the position and to the team. Position available in Vic, Qld, WA, and NSW

JOB OVERVIEW
Electrical Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and testing electrical systems and components, ensuring they meet required safety standards, performance specifications, and regulatory guidelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES include but are not limited to:
Contribute to the design of primary and secondary electrical systems, including switchgear, transformers, and protection systems
Support the development of schematics and one-line diagrams for substation layouts, ensuring optimal electrical distribution and safety
Work with senior engineers to create comprehensive electrical design documents that meet both operational and regulatory requirements
Provide technical expertise by way of reviewing and refining substation layout drawings, ensuring they are aligned with system performance expectations and safety codes
Use software and perform detailed calculations to plan, design and develop manufacturing, construction and installation standards and specifications to improve electrical systems
Participate in relay setting configurations to ensure coordinated protection for fault isolation and equipment safeguarding
Support the analysis of fault current levels, system protection schemes, and relay settings for substation equipment
Assist in selecting and sizing electrical equipment such as transformers, circuit breakers, cables, and busbars based on power ratings and system voltage levels
Collaborate with civil, mechanical, and systems engineers to ensure that all substation components are integrated seamlessly into the design
Participate in risk assessments to identify potential hazards and propose mitigation strategies
Review designs to ensure safe operation of electrical equipment and implement safety features such as grounding, emergency trip circuits, and fault isolation systems
Maintain thorough documentation of design decisions, equipment specifications, and protection schemes for accurate project execution
Document all design revisions, including any changes in equipment specifications, settings, and system configurations
Perform detailed reviews and quality checks on electrical designs, ensuring they meet project and compliance requirements
Maintain compliance with operational standards to ensure the substation meets grid stability and power quality requirements
Assist with any ad hoc duties as required

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS

MANDATORY HARD SKILLS
Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering
A minimum of 2 years of experience in electrical engineering

SOFT SKILLS
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication skills both written and verbal
High level of attention to detail and ability to work proactively
Ability to work confidently both as part of a team and autonomously

If you have the skills required for this role and you feel this is the job for you, then apply now!

result.description:
## ICT Support and Test Engineers (nec)
## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Support and Test Engineer to join our team and play a key role in maintaining the integrity, performance, and quality of our systems and infrastructure. This role combines technical support, quality assurance, and systems testing to ensure seamless operations and adherence to established standards. The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to problem-solving, strong communication skills, and a solid foundation in ICT systems and environments. This position suits an experienced professional who thrives in a collaborative setting and is committed to delivering high-quality technical outcomes.
## Key Responsibilities
- Schedule and conduct quality audit inspections across systems, data, and documentation, identifying variations and potential high-risk areas to ensure continued adherence to established standards and procedures.
- Investigate, diagnose, and resolve system problems and performance issues, providing hands-on troubleshooting support for desktops, hardware, software, printers, databases, operating systems, email platforms, and network connectivity.
- Test the functionality, behaviour, and integrity of systems and application code within defined testing protocols and quality frameworks, identifying and documenting errors, faults, and deviations from specification.
- Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance processes, guidelines, and strategies to support system reliability, security, and performance across the organisation.
- Recommend and facilitate corrective action plans to address non-compliance issues identified through ongoing monitoring, auditing, and review of operational processes and procedures.
- Perform organisational systems architecture reviews and assessments, providing well-informed recommendations on current and future hardware and software strategies aligned with business needs.
- Develop and deliver technical guidance, training, and support to end users and stakeholders on application software, operational procedures, and best practice usage.
- Communicate and liaise effectively with users and management to promote awareness of quality control standards, data integrity requirements, and ICT compliance obligations.
- Create, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, technical specifications, testing reports, and maintenance inventory records.
- Assist in the planning and execution of system upgrades, installations, configurations, and patch management activities to minimise disruption and maintain system availability.
- Monitor and evaluate system infrastructure to proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, contributing to the ongoing optimisation of ICT environments.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams and project stakeholders to support the delivery of ICT initiatives and ensure quality outcomes are achieved throughout the project lifecycle.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline; or equivalent demonstrated experience in a similar ICT role.
- Proven experience in ICT technical support, systems testing, or quality assurance within a professional environment.
- Strong understanding of testing methodologies, quality assurance frameworks, and audit processes across systems and software.
- Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across a broad range of ICT systems, including hardware, software, operating systems, and network components.
- Experience developing and maintaining technical documentation such as test plans, procedural guides, specifications, and operational manuals.
- Solid knowledge of database management, system security, backup procedures, and infrastructure performance monitoring.
- Proficiency in diagnosing software and hardware faults and delivering appropriate solutions within agreed timeframes and service levels.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach to quality assurance and issue resolution.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team, managing competing priorities and deadlines effectively.
## Preferred Qualifications
- Relevant industry certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Network+, ISTQB (Software Testing), or Microsoft Certified qualifications.
- Experience with enterprise-level systems, cloud platforms, or virtualisation technologies such as AWS, Azure, or VMware.
- Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) tools such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Zendesk.
- Exposure to Agile or DevOps delivery environments and associated testing practices such as continuous integration and automated testing.
- Previous experience conducting formal ICT audits, architecture reviews, or compliance assessments.
- Knowledge of relevant Australian and international ICT standards and frameworks, including ISO/IEC 27001 or COBIT.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team that values innovation, continuous improvement, and professional growth.
- Access ongoing learning and development opportunities, including support for professional certifications and industry training.
- Enjoy a flexible work environment with options for hybrid working arrangements to support work-life balance.
- Contribute to meaningful, large-scale ICT projects that have a real impact on organisational performance and service delivery.
- Competitive salary package with opportunities for career progression within a growing and dynamic technology function.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Pitstop Truck and Tyre Repairs is looking for an experienced Diesel Mechanic to join our team in Craigieburn. We specialise in the full spectrum of truck and tyre servicing, from scheduled maintenance through to complex mechanical overhauls, and we hold ourselves to a high standard of precision and workmanship on every job.
This role suits an experienced diesel mechanic who is comfortable working across a range of heavy vehicles and wants to be part of a workshop that takes quality seriously. You will work on real trucks with real complexity, not light vehicles dressed up as diesel work.

- Diagnose faults across heavy diesel engines, fuel systems, turbochargers, air brake systems, and driveline components using both hands-on inspection and computer-based diagnostic tools

- Carry out scheduled servicing including oil and filter changes, brake adjustments, lubrications, and engine tune-ups to maintain compliance and vehicle performance
- Perform post-repair testing and adjustment to confirm correct operation before vehicles are returned to service
- Inspect vehicles and assess roadworthiness, detailing required remedial work where applicable
- Maintain accurate job records and service documentation

About you
- Experience working on diesel-powered vehicles or equipment in a professional workshop or field environment
- Competent with electronic diagnostic tools and fault-finding processes
- Sound knowledge of diesel engine systems and related mechanical components
- High attention to detail with a methodical approach to fault diagnosis and repair
- Able to manage multiple jobs concurrently and work efficiently in a fast-paced workshop
- Current driver's licence required; additional licensing may be required depending on the role
- Roadworthy certification authority desirable but not essential

?? Salary: AUD $80,000 – $85,000 + Superannuation

Royal Mechanical Group Pty Ltd, trading as Royal Poly Products, is a Perth-based Australian engineering and manufacturing company specialising in pipeline pigging and pipeline maintenance solutions for the oil & gas, mining, water, and infrastructure sectors.
We design and manufacture engineered pipeline pigs and support pipeline inspection and pigging operations through practical engineering, field experience, instrumentation support, and in-house R&D capabilities.


About the Role
We are seeking a motivated and technically capable Automation & Control Engineer to join our growing engineering team in Perth.
This role will focus on the design, integration, and optimisation of instrumentation, control systems, and data-driven technologies used in advanced pipeline pigging and inspection applications. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams on smart inspection technologies, sensor integration, testing, and automation initiatives.
This is an exciting opportunity for an engineer looking to work on innovative products within a niche and highly specialised industry.


Key Responsibilities

Design and validate pipeline pig configurations using engineering calculations, MATLAB models, and performance analysis tools
Support development of instrumentation, monitoring, and data acquisition systems used in pipeline pigging and inspection operations
Assist in integration and evaluation of sensors, pig tracking instrumentation, and related pipeline monitoring technologies
Analyse pig performance, sealing efficiency, wear characteristics, and operational suitability across various pipeline conditions
Support testing, commissioning, and validation activities for pigging tools and associated instrumentation systems
Manage and maintain rental pig detection and tracking equipment, ensuring operational readiness and calibration compliance
Support development of pigging philosophies, operational procedures, and engineering recommendations for pipeline systems
Apply Python and/or MATLAB for engineering analysis, automation support, modelling, and data interpretation
Prepare technical reports, engineering documentation, validation records, and controlled revisions
Participate in research and development activities related to in-house smart pigging, automation, and pipeline inspection technologies
Collaborate with manufacturing, operations, and engineering teams to support product development and continuous improvement initiatives
Skills & Competencies

Strong understanding of instrumentation and control systems
Exposure to pipeline pig manufacturing industry and relevant instrumentation is essential
Analytical and problem-solving mindset
Understanding of data acquisition systems and sensor technologies
Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams
Strong communication and technical documentation skills
Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, Automation, or related discipline)
2–4 years of relevant engineering experience in pipeline pig manufacturing is preferred
Exposure to industrial automation, instrumentation, or embedded systems is advantageous
Preferred Tools & Systems

SolidWorks
Python and/or MATLAB
PLC/SCADA systems (desirable)
Why Join Us?

Work on cutting-edge pipeline inspection and automation technologies
Be part of a growing Australian engineering and manufacturing company
Exposure to international oil & gas and infrastructure projects
Opportunity to contribute directly to R&D and product innovation
Clear pathway toward technical leadership and advanced engineering roles

sales@royalmechgroup.com
